name: @streamlinelabs/sdk
description: Node.js SDK for Streamline - The AI-Native Streaming Platform

scripts.smoke:cjs: node -e "const s=require('./dist/index.js'); const missing=['Streamline','Producer','Consumer','UnsupportedOperationError'].filter(k=>s[k]===undefined); if(missing.length){console.error('CJS build is missing exports: '+missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('CJS require smoke test OK');"
scripts.smoke:esm: node -e "import('./dist/index.mjs').then(m=>{const missing=['Streamline','Producer','Consumer','UnsupportedOperationError'].filter(k=>m[k]===undefined); if(missing.length){console.error('ESM build is missing exports: '+missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('ESM import smoke test OK');}).catch(e=>{console.error(e); process.exit(1);});"
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:cjs && npm run smoke:esm && npm run smoke:workspaces
scripts.verify:tag: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; const raw=process.env.RELEASE_TAG||process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME||''; const t=raw.replace(/^v/,''); if(!t){console.error('No release tag found: set RELEASE_TAG or GITHUB_REF_NAME'); process.exit(1);} if(t!==v){console.error('Release tag '+raw+' does not match package version '+v); process.exit(1);} console.log('Release tag matches package version '+v);"
scripts.validate: npm run audit:runtime && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:examples && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run test && npm run test:workspaces && npm run build && npm run build:workspaces && npm run smoke && npm run pack:dry
